name: SOL Landing Expansion
milestone: One consolidated landing expansion for Mars, Europa, Titan and Triton on top of the validated Moon path
solLandingPolicy: Real landing enabled through the surface-support layer for Moon, Mars, Europa, Titan and Triton; Earth, Mercury, Venus, Io, Ganymede, Callisto and gas/ice giants remain landing-disabled
surfaceSkyObserverPolicy: massless body-fixed observer remains available on supported solid SOL reference worlds; spacecraft remains in live Newtonian flight
surfaceSkyTerrainPolicy: flat schematic horizon only; no claim of real terrain, geology, POIs, weather or landing capability
surfaceSkyAstronomyPolicy: reuse inherited AstronomicalObserverModel, body rotation, physical angular size, phase and finite-disk eclipse/occultation geometry
moonDefaultSitePolicy: sub-parent body-fixed point at current simulation epoch
planetDefaultSitePolicy: body-fixed point beneath current spacecraft direction
surfaceSkySavePolicy: observer camera is not serialized as a landed surface session; physical ship/system save state remains canonical
flightNavigationPolicy: Newtonian gravity/integrator, ship dynamics, flight computer, FRAME/transit, SOL reference states, eclipse/phase astronomy, body rotation and landing transition/takeoff state machine remain unchanged from v0.1.0.5C.1
mobileCachePolicy: Version every changed runtime edge for Safari/GitHub Pages: index/main -> app -> threeRenderer/surfaceGenerator/surfaceProfiles -> surfaceWorld.
scope: Bounded SOL landing expansion only. Adds explicit surface-support profiles for Mars, Europa, Titan and Triton while preserving the Moon and keeping Earth for a later dedicated atmosphere/surface milestone.
surfaceSkyPresentationPolicy: Resolved planet/moon disks lazily reuse the same deterministic global albedo-map generator as the space renderer while retaining authoritative angular size, phase, eclipse state and position.
saturnRingPresentation: main C/B/A rings rendered at NASA/NSSDCA radial ratios with Cassini Division preserved; ring plane follows canonical Saturn spin axis; no ring particle dynamics/self-shadow/radiative transfer
surfaceSkyRingPolicy: Saturn C/B/A main rings are presentation geometry scaled from published Saturn-radius ratios; ring particles are not individual gravity sources
surfaceSkyFovPolicy: camera-only FOV presets 70/35/15/5/1.5 degrees; no celestial position, radius, orbit or spacecraft state is modified
surfaceSkyFocusPolicy: NEXT/CENTER/FOV/DETAILS are shared by reference SURFACE SKY and fully landed surface sessions. CENTER changes observer yaw/pitch only; NEXT changes selected presentation target; below-horizon and off-screen targets are explicitly labeled.
moonLandingSurfacePolicy: Moon mass/radius/gravity/rotation and live sky remain authoritative SOL state; local regolith terrain/geology are deterministic procedural proxies, not a real lunar topographic map
moonLandingTransitionPolicy: reuse inherited scripted descent → touchdown → on-foot exploration → BOARD/TAKEOFF → Hill-screened circular return-orbit handoff
marsSurfacePolicy: Established atmospheric-rocky engine driven by SOL reference gravity, 636 Pa atmosphere, albedo, rotation and live sky; terrain/weather are bounded presentation proxies, not mapped Mars topography or solved climate.
europaSurfacePolicy: Established ice/volatile engine driven by SOL reference gravity/exosphere/rotation/live sky; airless presentation and no invented weather.
titanSurfacePolicy: Established ice/volatile terrain engine driven by SOL reference gravity and 146.7 kPa N2/CH4 atmosphere; dense haze is a bounded aerosol/tint presentation proxy, with methane meteorology/chemistry not solved.
tritonSurfacePolicy: Established ice/volatile engine driven by SOL reference gravity, 1.4 Pa trace N2/CH4 atmosphere, rotation and live Neptune sky; terrain is a cryogenic presentation proxy.
